messages:
maya: Pushed an updated 'Scaling Configurator' modal to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/scale-config (frame: 'Configurator v3'). Need a quick UX + a11y sweep focused on: min/max UX, burst options, pool picker, SLO control, and guardrail copy. Deadline: Friday. jules: Quick pass: love the layout. A couple suggestions: - Make min/max visually grouped with a label row: 'Reserved capacity' so it's clear these are guaranteed GPUs. - Add unit hint after inputs: e.g. '4 GPUs' or '8 vGPU slots' depending on pool. Don't rely on placeholder alone. - The pool selector should show small meta tags (region, gpu-family) to avoid mistakes. rachel: Frontend notes: - Inputs must enforce integers; show inline helper if decimal typed: 'We round to whole GPUs.' - Pool selector needs typeahead for orgs with lots of pools. Use aria-activedescendant on the list. - When a pool switch could break the model, show a non-blocking inline banner in yellow with a 'View compatibility' link. tom: Backend constraints and proposals: - We store burst as 'burst_minutes' budget per pool; we'll expose remaining budget via /pools/{id}/burst_status. - Min/max are ints; we'll reject saves with min > max and return helpful error codes. - When pool gpu-family != model.family, return compatibility hint in the response so UI can show the badge. heidi: Accessibility issues I saw: - SLO knob labels (tiny grey numbers) fail contrast. Increase weight or use darker color. - Ensure slider has keyboard support: arrow keys +/-1, page up/down +/-10, home/end to min/max. - For the burst toggle, add aria-checked and an aria-describedby pointing to a short explanation region. jules: Copy suggestions (short): - Modal title: 'Capacity & scaling' (more discoverable). - Burst toggle label: 'Allow temporary burst capacity' (followed by small hint: 'extra GPUs for short spikes'). - Guardrail language: change 'triggered' to 'recommended action' to reduce alarm. rachel: UI behavior proposal: - Show 'Recommended min' beneath min input with a small clock icon: 'Recommended: 3 (based on 4h avg)'. Clickable to auto-fill. - Collapse advanced items (burst cooldown, burst budget) under 'Advanced options' shown only when burst enabled. tom: Implementation note: exposing 'remaining burst minutes' in realtime will be eventual — we'll provide a cached value + timestamp: '45 min remaining (updated 2m ago)'. UI should surface freshness. maya: Good. A few edge cases: - If user enables burst but pool limit < requested burst, show clear validation and a 'Request increase' CTA linking to support. - For mixes of vGPUs and full GPUs, show a tooltip that explains allocation differences. heidi: Small ARIA snippet to read out slider nicely: ```
Use arrows to change by 1%. Hold shift for 10% jumps. ``` jules: Also ensure the warning banner is not color-only: add 'Warning:' prefix and a caution icon. Use role="alert" for important blocks. rachel: Keyboard nav checklist I'll follow in PR: tab order through inputs, pool search with arrow keys, sliders respond to arrows and page keys, and escape closes modal. tom: I'll add the compatibility flag to the pool list API so the UI can show mismatches on selection without another roundtrip. infra-bot: Snapshot uploaded: figma-export-1764912345.png maya: Action items: @jules update Figma with grouped reserved capacity, burst hint text, and advanced collapsing. @heidi to finalize aria text and contrast swatches. @rachel will wire the typeahead + integer enforcement. @tom to return API mock for burst_status and pool compatibility by Monday. We'll reconvene Mon 3pm PT for sign-off. Thanks! :rocket: jules: On it heidi: Will validate with VoiceOver and NVDA before sign-off rachel: adding QA checklist to PR maya: Thanks team :)
